## Change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and the scope of the change.

## Validation

List the checks performed and any remaining limitations. Include before/after
screenshots for interface changes using public or synthetic images.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] This community pull request targets `develop`.
- [ ] The change preserves source geometry, frame/layer scope, and lock protection.
- [ ] Relevant tests and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No private images, credentials, study backups, or generated runtime files are included.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this change under the applicable component license.

Maintainer promotion pull requests from `develop` to `main` may leave the first
checkbox unchecked and describe which reviewed changes are being released.
